To Whom It May Concern,

I am writing to recommend Rhodas Demissew Tadesse, whom I had the opportunity to teach in Logic Design and Computer Networks in the Bachelor of Science in Computer Science program at HiLCoE School of Computer Science and Technology.

Throughout both courses, Rhodas showed a genuine commitment to understanding the material and worked especially well with others. This was most evident during the final project, when he led his team. He took time to understand each member’s strengths and organized the work so everyone could contribute effectively. Through regular meetings, he kept the group on schedule, brought different ideas together, and helped ensure the final submission was cohesive rather than a collection of separate parts. What stood out was his ability to combine organization with good judgment and collaborative leadership, qualities that will serve him well in professional settings.

Outside the classroom, his interest in networking went beyond what the course syllabus required. He completed two Cisco certifications, Switching, Routing and Wireless Essentials and Enterprise Networking, Security and Automation, which tells me he is willing to learn independently. That matters a great deal in a field that changes as quickly as technology does. He graduated in 2025 with a cumulative GPA of 3.52 and an A+ on his senior project, a research management system built on the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js and Node.js) with REST APIs, which gave him early experience building real software as part of a team. He has since carried that experience into professional work as a full-stack developer.

During the time he was in my class, he was also unfortunately dealing with a health issue though, he still attended lectures regularly, followed them attentively and submitted every assignment on time. That kind of consistency under difficult personal circumstances is a quality I value in a student, because it shows he can be relied on when conditions are not ideal. He earned a well-deserved A in Logic Design.

Taken together, Rhodas combines technical ability with discipline, initiative and the capacity to lead. I am confident he will make a meaningful contribution in any role or program that draws on these qualities, and I recommend him without hesitation. Please feel free to contact me if further information is needed.

Sincerely,

Bisratie Tesfaye
